items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: When the thing started to flourish for the new bands was Tito Puente and Tito Rodriguez, so we three played there at the Palladium.

ctx.x: Was there any other band as versatile as the Machito band in '47, '48 or '49?
No, no. When the thing started to flourish for the new bands was Tito Puente and Tito Rodriguez, so we three played there at the Palladium.
Uh-Huh, okay. Ahh you also had a place called Cubop City, which that's the name that Symphony Sid gave it. You used to be located above Jack Dempsey's on 51st Street. How did you get to work there?
